The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1920–1921''' was contested by 43 teams participating in four divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, southern and western football division of the [[Netherlands]]. [[NAC Breda|NAC]] won this year's championship by beating [[Be Quick 1887]], [[AFC Ajax]], and [[Go Ahead Eagles|Go Ahead]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse East:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[TSV Theole]]
'''Eerste Klasse North:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[GVV Groningen]]
'''Eerste Klasse South:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[FC Den Bosch|BVV Den Bosch]] & [[SV DOSKO]]
'''Eerste Klasse West:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[VVA/Spartaan|De Spartaan]]
